stem: Plutonium-238 (²³⁸₉₄Pu) is unstable and undergoes alpha decay.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the equation to show the decay of plutonium-238.

²³⁸₉₄Pu → [[blank]]U + [[blank]]α

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: The power source in a space probe contains 0.874 kg of plutonium-238. Each nucleus of plutonium-238 that decays emits 5.59 MeV of energy. The half-life of plutonium-238 is 87.7 years.
parts.text: Calculate the initial number *N*₀ of nuclei of plutonium-238 in the power source.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the initial activity of the source. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b)(ii) to determine the initial power output from the source due to the decay of plutonium-238.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
The space probe will continue to function until the power output from the plutonium in the source decreases to 65.3% of its initial value.

Calculate the time, in years, for which the space probe will function.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
An alternative power source uses energy generated from the radioactive decay of polonium-210. This isotope has a half-life of 0.378 years. The mass of the isotope needed for the same initial power output as in (b) is 3.37 g.

Suggest one advantage and one disadvantage of using polonium-210 as the source of energy.
